stem:
Falguni sorts picture cards for a class display. One card shows a rocky asteroid orbiting between Mars and Jupiter; another shows the bright star Sirius far beyond the planets.

Which choice correctly places the objects and how they get light?

options.text: Both the asteroid and Sirius belong to the Solar System and both shine by making their own light.
The asteroid belongs to the Solar System and shines by reflecting sunlight; Sirius is outside the Solar System and shines with its own light.
Only the Sun and the eight planets belong to the Solar System, so the asteroid is excluded.
Sirius belongs to the Solar System because it looks very bright from Earth.

teacher.key_rationale: Asteroids in the Solar System reflect sunlight. Sirius is a star outside the Solar System and makes its own light.
